item.title: BOSS Launches GX-1B Bass Multi-Effects Pedal with 130+ Effects at $229
item.description: The new BOSS GX-1B bass multi-effects pedal offers AIRD amp modeling, 130+ effects, Bluetooth streaming, and flexible power options in a compact design.

item.title: Gorillaz Reveal 2026 North American Tour Featuring Live Bassist Seye Adelekan
item.description: Gorillaz have announced their first extensive North American tour in four years behind the new album The Mountain. The arena run features bassist Seye Adelekan in the live band, with support from Little Simz and Deltron 3030.

item.title: Watch Jacob Umansky Rip Through Intercval's “Lacuna” on the Dingwall Sol Signature Bass
item.description: Jacob Umansky demos his Dingwall Sol Signature at NAMM 2026 with a full playthrough of Intervals’ “Lacuna,” all clank, clarity, and control

item.title: This G Major Bass Exercise Will Push Your Left-Hand Stretch to the Limit
item.description: Bassist Marek Bero shares a challenging Bass Gym exercise in G major designed to strengthen your left hand, expand your reach, and unlock new interval possibilities on the fretboard.

item.title: Sting’s Sting 3.0 Tour Expands with Fall 2026 Dates and Brooklyn Residency
item.description: Sting has announced a fall 2026 North American leg of his Sting 3.0 tour, performing in a trio with Dominic Miller and Chris Maas. See the full list of dates.

item.title: Mastodon Unleash “Blood and Thunder” at Bloodstock 2025
item.description: Watch Mastodon rip through “Blood and Thunder” at Bloodstock 2025, with Troy Sanders locking in the low end on one of metal’s most enduring tracks.

item.title: Mane Custom Bass Launches KJ5 Series with Exotic Woods and Bartolini Electronics
item.description: Mane Custom Bass has launched the KJ5 Series, a new lineup featuring four models with exotic tonewoods, Bartolini electronics, and 35-inch scale options in 4-, 5-, and 6-string configurations.

item.title: Anthrax Bassist Frank Bello Gets Signature Hybrid Nickel Strings with Dunlop
item.description: Dunlop has teamed up with Anthrax bassist Frank Bello to release Hybrid Nickel Wound bass strings designed for clarity, punch, and a fat low end.

item.title: Billy Sheehan in Action: Mr. Big’s “Take Cover” Surfaces from 2009 Japan Show
item.description: Mr. Big have released a live clip of “Take Cover” from a massive 2009 show in Japan, featuring Billy Sheehan on his red Yamaha Attitude and Paul Gilbert in top form.

item.title: Upton Bass Launches Chicago Double Bass Inspired by the Kay M-1
item.description: Upton Bass has unveiled the Chicago upright bass, a new model inspired by the legendary Kay M-1 and built using original Kay rib molds.
